caption: The drawing depicts two human figures centrally placed within a turquoise, arch-shaped frame that features decorative flower and leaf shapes in green, red, and yellow. The larger figure is a woman with pale skin and black hair, wearing a yellow crown with red details, a white collar, a green upper garment, and a large, full skirt composed of overlapping shapes in dark green, light green, and red. She cradles a smaller crowned child in her right arm, who is dressed in red and has a pale face, both with stylized facial features. Surrounding the figures and within the frame are stylized vines with red, yellow, and green leaves and buds forming a symmetrical, decorative border. The background is plain and neutral, while the overall composition is highly symmetrical and uses bold flats of color.
title: Wooden Retablo, San Antonio
